cues.en: Instructor: This unsupervised learning challenge involves a little bit of linear algebra in the sense that there are some special matrices and there's matrix multiplication in here.
cues.zh: 講師：這個無監督學習挑戰涉及一點線性代數，因為會用到一些特殊矩陣與矩陣乘法。

cues.en: So if you are not really comfortable with linear algebra, then you might struggle a little bit more with this code challenge compared to some of the other learning challenges, but I believe you can still
cues.zh: 如果你不太熟悉線性代數，這個程式挑戰可能比其他挑戰更吃力一點，但我相信你仍然能

cues.en: successfully complete this.
cues.zh: 順利完成。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the idea.
cues.zh: 概念如下。

cues.en: We can express the relationship between a covariance matrix and a correlation matrix using this equation here.
cues.zh: 可以用這裡的方程式，表示共變異數矩陣與相關矩陣之間的關係。

cues.en: So C is a covariance matrix of a dataset.
cues.zh: C 是一份資料集的共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: R is the correlation matrix of that same dataset.
cues.zh: R 是同一份資料集的相關矩陣。

cues.en: And sigma here is a diagonal matrix with the standard deviations of the dataset in the diagonal elements.
cues.zh: 這裡的 sigma 是對角矩陣，對角線元素是資料集的標準差。

cues.en: Now, if you don't know what a diagonal matrix means, it's just a matrix where all of the off diagonal elements are zero.
cues.zh: 如果你不知道對角矩陣是什麼，就是所有非對角線元素都為 0 的矩陣。

cues.en: So most of the matrix elements are zeros and the elements on the diagonal and the diagonal of a matrix.
cues.zh: 大部分矩陣元素都是 0，而對角線上的元素——矩陣的對角線，

cues.en: So here's our matrix here.
cues.zh: 這裡是矩陣。

cues.en: The diagonal elements go from the top left down to the bottom right.
cues.zh: 對角線元素從左上延伸到右下。

cues.en: So it's that diagonal going from top left to bottom right, that is the diagonal of a matrix, and that contains the standard deviations in the diagonals
cues.zh: 從左上到右下的那條斜線，就是矩陣的對角線。這裡的對角線放標準差，

cues.en: and zeros everywhere else.
cues.zh: 其餘位置都是 0。

cues.en: Okay? So here's what you wanna do in this unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 這個無監督學習挑戰要做的事情如下。

cues.en: First of all, you need to create a small data set.
cues.zh: 首先建立一份小型資料集。

cues.en: I recommend keeping the matrices pretty small so they're easy to visually inspect because you want to be able to look at these matrices.
cues.zh: 我建議矩陣保持小一點，方便目視檢查，因為你會想直接查看這些矩陣。

cues.en: So you know, for example, you can have, create a data set that has four features and 10 observations.
cues.zh: 例如，可以建立有 4 個特徵、10 筆觀察的資料集。

cues.en: You could think of it like a questionnaire with four items, and you give it to 10 people.
cues.zh: 可以想像成有 4 個題目的問卷，發給 10 個人。

cues.en: You could think of it as a multi-variate signal data set where you have four channels and 10 time points.
cues.zh: 也可以想成多變量訊號資料集，有 4 個通道、10 個時間點。

cues.en: However you wanna think about it is fine.
cues.zh: 怎麼想都可以。

cues.en: Now, you don't have to pick four in 10, but you know it should be somewhere small and manageable.
cues.zh: 不一定要選 4 和 10，但應該選小而容易處理的大小。

cues.en: So then you compute the co variance matrix and the correlation matrix, and of course those are going to be four by four or you know, whatever is the number of features that you define.
cues.zh: 接著計算共變異數矩陣與相關矩陣，當然會是 4 乘 4，或你指定的特徵數所對應的大小。

cues.en: Now, C and R of course, are not going to be equal.
cues.zh: C 與 R 當然不會相等。

cues.en: They're related to each other as you learned in I guess it was, I think the second video in this session.
cues.zh: 它們彼此有關係，這在本單元，大概是第二支影片已經學過。

cues.en: But in general, we do not expect C and R to be the same.
cues.zh: 但一般而言，不預期 C 與 R 相同。

cues.en: So then what you need to do is compute the standard deviations of each feature and put those standard deviations into the corresponding diagonal elements of this matrix.
cues.zh: 然後，計算各特徵的標準差，把標準差放入這個矩陣對應的對角線元素。

cues.en: And then you're going to have three matrices, C and R and sigma.
cues.zh: 於是就有 C、R 與 sigma 三個矩陣。

cues.en: And then basically you implement this equation and you show that C is equal to sigma times R times sigma.
cues.zh: 接著實作這個方程式，證明 C 等於 sigma 乘 R 再乘 sigma。

cues.en: So you wanna find that the right hand side of the equation is equal to the left hand side of the equation, and that gives us the transformation from R to C.
cues.zh: 要確認方程式右側等於左側，如此就得到從 R 轉換到 C 的方法。

cues.en: Now, if you are familiar with linear algebra, for example, if you've taken my course on linear algebra, then you can do even more.
cues.zh: 如果你熟悉線性代數，例如上過我的線性代數課，還可以做更多。

cues.en: You can explore this concept even more, for example, by showing that you can put these sigmas onto the other side of C or the other side of the equation to find out how
cues.zh: 可以進一步探索這個概念，例如把這些 sigma 移到 C 的另一側，或方程式另一側，看看如何

cues.en: to compute a correlation matrix from a covariance matrix by isolating R on the right hand side of the equation.
cues.zh: 將右側的 R 單獨留下，從共變異數矩陣計算相關矩陣。

cues.en: And also, if you've taken my linear algebra course, you can think about why it is that we need to pre multiply and also post multiply by the standard deviations, first
cues.zh: 如果上過我的線性代數課，也可以思考，為什麼前乘與後乘都要用標準差，首先，

cues.en: of all, and not the variances.
cues.zh: 為什麼不是變異數？

cues.en: And second of all, why it has to be on the left and on the right, and why we couldn't just multiply by the variances on one side.
cues.zh: 其次，為什麼必須左、右各乘一次，而不能只在一側乘以變異數？

cues.en: Anyway, that would be slightly more advanced things.
cues.zh: 這些是稍微進階的內容。

cues.en: The main thing to do is compute C, compute sigma and R, and show that this quantity here, this matrix multiplication, is equal to the matrix C covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 主要要做的是計算 C、sigma 與 R，證明這裡的量，也就是這個矩陣乘法，等於共變異數矩陣 C。
